scope: Saved assistant task observation after project-context hydration; not execution approval or field-quality acceptance.
cause: An automatic saved-task GET is correctly discarded when project/data/settings authority changes during hydration; the former panel effect did not arrange a fresh current-context read and could leave the task/history empty. Original Linux trace recording was disabled for privacy; source-supported race was reproduced by the real controller/store/panel with a deferred GET.
repair: Panel-owned read-only intent coalesces context notifications and issues one single-flight saved-state GET per current context token. A changed connection needs fresh panel intent. No stale payload acceptance or action replay.
preserved_guards: manual stop, errors/timeouts, explicit history, prepared new requests and panel unmount suppress hidden reads
current tasks and busy/loading state are preserved
unchanged empty ledger is read once, without a timer loop
backend and Geti source trees unchanged
GUI history manifests and workflow files unchanged
